verification_rule: The card supplies meaning, the live hostname supplies proof, the match is what makes it evidence. Compare the live hostname case-insensitively against ANY entry in attested_hostnames; if that key is absent or empty, fall back to v1's singular attested_hostname. verified is three-state: true on a match, false on a mismatch, null when the hostname could not be read at all. Never collapse false and null -- a copied workspace and an unreadable hostname are different facts.
